summary: Allow asynchronous Codex Skip processing before raising attention

compatibility.detail: After the once-only Codex Escape/Skip, preserve the readiness fence during one existing 10-second screen-poll interval; a persistent menu raises the existing attention after that interval. Skip applies to this start and does not select Skip until next version.

downtime.detail: No provider upgrade, service restart or downtime procedure.

manual.detail: Provider upgrades remain Operations-owned. Unrecognized menus and failed sends immediately retain attention; no additional manual procedure.

recovery.detail: Existing prompt/restored episode history remains authoritative; no key retry or readiness inferred from a send.
